title: bus_client's harbor_source asks harbor_master for get traffic over the bus
intention: cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py:93 harbor_source() imports traffic_image from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.harbor_master.voyage and hands that function to the web server: a reach into harbor_master laundered through a tool. Since cd36b8e86cd3 harbor_master answers get traffic over the bus. harbor_source() returns a callable that asks it: get traffic on a reach('harbor_master') bus held after the first ask, the reply's data returned, a refusal raised loudly.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-encapsulation-holds naming cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py:93 importing cairn.devices.cairn.machines.harbor_master.voyage. RULE 1 makes the bus harbor_master's public interface; outline 15.3.4 has the web server ask devices for what to draw over the bus (get/show).
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 15.3.4 (the web server asks devices for what to draw over the bus); outline 17.13.1.
how: In bus_client.py harbor_source(*, ask=None) returns traffic_image(); traffic_image() sends get with body {what: traffic} to harbor_master through ask() when injected, else through one reach('harbor_master') bus built on the first call and kept; it returns reply['body']['data'] and raises RuntimeError naming the reason when the body is not accepted. No import of cairn.devices remains in harbor_source. New proof cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_the_harbor_source_asks_over_the_bus.py, four teeth.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds finds no breach from a file under cairn/tools/bus_client landing on cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master
harbor_source(ask=...)() sends get with what=traffic to harbor_master and returns the reply's data; a refused reply raises naming its reason
harbor_source()() over the live bus returns a traffic image (gates, at_anchor, berthed, counts)

decisions.text: D1: ask, then keep the bus: the reach bus is built on the first ask and reused, so /harbor pays the wiring once and the web server's start pays nothing.
